clarification_version: node 8.9 result-free preregistration before any OCR-SMARC method score
node_8_9_reason: replace infeasible cross-object proximity matching with train-only conditional-residual swaps that cover every object while preserving fitted conditional means and within-object structure

render.material: neutral static gray/mobile light gray on dark neutral background
render.renderer: triangle faces with z-buffer; convex-hull/point splats forbidden for formal run
render.kinematic_topology: moving link includes full child subtree; static part includes all other links
render.normalization: per-object full-articulation bounding box only; no dataset statistics
render.coverage_gate: 1.0: every visual mesh/primitive assigned exactly once to moving subtree or static complement

data.joins: replayed node4 key; model batch strips key/split/family/object_group_id/joint_id
data.mechanical: swap-invariant mean/abs-difference surface features plus absolute observed displacement; remove train-constant columns
data.family_policy: Articraft three-family leave-one-family-out with every fold and aggregate reported (USB fold flagged small); NJC family audit NOT_APPLICABLE_BY_NO_TAXONOMY
data.domain_policy: one joint Articraft+NJC model trained on Articraft97 plus NJC11; Articraft12 and NJC4 remain validation-only; after source gate the same single frozen joint model is the only Box candidate

model.semantic_path: softmax gate only; no semantic additive prediction
model.global_prior: training-only mean feasible completion fraction transformed to fixed logit
model.projection: Euclidean nonnegative two-simplex at exact predicted range

optimization.loss: mean joints/gauges within object, then equal mean objects within domain, then equal mean Articraft/NJC domains; plus 0.01 gate-load-balance
optimization.global_prior_and_pca: fit on training objects with the same object-uniform and domain-balanced weighting; refit independently inside every LOFO audit replica

conditional_residual_contract.unit: opaque object group; every joint/gauge retains its recipient within-object offset
conditional_residual_contract.fit: per-domain train-only object-equal unregularized float64 SVD OLS of object-mean field on [1,z]; fail if Var(z)<=1e-12 or rank<2
conditional_residual_contract.semantic_field: frozen train-only PCA16 DINO pair latent; z is object-mean absolute observed displacement
conditional_residual_contract.mechanical_field: joint-training-set domain-balanced standardized nonconstant geometry only; z is semantic cosine distance to the train-domain mean; recipient displacement is bit-identical
conditional_residual_contract.train_mapping: within each domain opaque-ID sorted cyclic shift one; self rate zero and donor marginal exactly one
conditional_residual_contract.held_mapping: within each domain opaque-ID sorted held objects receive opaque-ID sorted train residual donors in balanced round-robin

crossfit.assignment: sort by sha256('splart-ocrsmarc-crossfit-v1:'+opaque_object_id), then balanced round-robin modulo 5
crossfit.diagnostic: absolute Spearman between residual-vector norm and z plus distance correlation between residual vector and z

gate.analytic_control_rule: for each domain/control compare against min(historical row-uniform MARE, hierarchy-weighted MARE)
